t: Titan sanding roll set offers robust abrasive paper for comprehensive wood preparation and finishing tasks. This versatile pack is essential for joiners, carpenters, and DIYers undertaking furniture restoration, floor sanding, or general wood finishing projects. Includes 5m x 115mm rolls with 60, 80, and 120 grit aluminium oxide abrasive, providing the right option for various sanding requirements on hardwood and softwood. The durable E-weight paper backing ensures long-lasting performance for hand sanding applications. These rolls are easily cut to size, optimising material usage for efficient surface preparation before painting, varnishing, or staining. For dry use only.
b: Easily Cut to Size for Custom Use
